question: Who unveiled the statue of the late Nathuram Mirdha in Nagaur, Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vice President.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• On** May 14, 2023**, Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar unveiled the statue of the late Nathuram Mirdha in Nagaur, Rajasthan.
 
• Nathuram Mirdha was a distinguished** freedom fighter and a prominent leader of the farming community.**
 
• His legacy includes serving as a **Union Minister and being elected six times to the Lok Sabha.**
 
• The ceremony highlighted Mirdha’s significant contributions to social work and his enduring vision for the farming community, celebrating his lifelong dedication to improving the lives of farmers and advocating for their rights.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jagdeep Dhankhar **(since August 11, 2022), affiliated with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• The Vice President is the** ex officio Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha** (Council of States), the upper house of India’s Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Rajasthan is the largest state in India**, covering an area of 342,239 square kilometers.
 
• It **shares borders** with Pakistan to the west and the Indian states of Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, and Gujarat.
 
• The Thar Desert, also known as the** Great Indian Desert**, covers a significant portion of Rajasthan.
 
• Jaipur is the capital of Rajasthan, also known as the** Pink City.**
